replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states free SQL editor on production replica; over-reading unrelated tables is concrete attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack: write/DDL/cross-database via connection privileges, not just reading entitled tables."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Heavy ad-hoc queries saturating the named production replica is a specific, distinct harm."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design names the production query action; lack of per-user query attribution is specific here."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design only names audience, no auth check; unauthenticated access differs from authorised over-read."}]}
